annotations.title: Compare two or three jobs side by side

description: Puts two or three named jobs side by side for someone choosing between them, e.g. 'nursing or teaching', 'should I become an electrician or a plumber', 'data analyst vs software engineer', 'physician assistant vs nurse practitioner', 'UX design or product management', 'accountant vs financial analyst, which is safer from AI', 'which is a better career, law or medicine'. For each job, returns what OffLadder has written about it across 228 jobs: whether the work would suit them and how to try it, how people get in, where it is heading and what AI changes in it, each with its direct answer and a link. Says which of the jobs it has nothing on. It does not rank the jobs or pick one: the comparison is for the person to weigh, and the suggested next step is a small test of each.

jobs.description: The two or three jobs to compare, each in the person's words, e.g. ['nurse', 'teacher'].

name: compare_jobs

continue_url.description: The same link, as the suggested next step.

cta_label.description: A short label for that link.

asked.description: The job as the person named it.

field.description: The broad field OffLadder files it under.

found.description: False when OffLadder has not written about this job.

kind.description: What the guide covers, e.g. 'Is it for me?' or 'AI and the job'.

jobs_url.description: OffLadder's index of every job it has written about.

start_url.description: OffLadder's short onboarding, with a starting world picked if one was clear.
